expectations.text: Rewrites API errors into what failed, why, and the next command to run
expectations.evidence: Errors Rule 1 says: 'Every error states what failed, why, and the next command.' The human-mode FLG-4031 rewrite shows all three. What failed: 'this token cannot change flags in "prod"'. Why: 'The token has read-only access to this environment.' Next: 'nb auth status' / 'nb auth login'. It also carries the request ID and a docs link. The catalog schema stores `message`, `why` and `next` (list of commands) for each code, and adds a 'never prints an API code alone' rule. expectations.text: Rewrites API errors into what failed, why, and the next command to run
expectations.evidence: Section 3 sends each API code through a catalog lookup and renders it in a fixed format: 'Error FLG-4031: <title>', a one-sentence 'what happened, naming the resource', 'Why: <likely cause>' and 'Fix: <command or action to take>'. It adds a docs link and a request ID. The worked example rewrites the raw code as 'Your token cannot change flag "new-checkout" in production. Why: the token has the "viewer" role...
